public_whitebox_allocation.non_concurrent_rule: Public encounter footprints are sequenced whitebox responsibilities, not simultaneously populated live zones.

session_whitebox_envelopes.fallback_gate: Only if four participants cannot simultaneously read the boss telegraph, purification nodes and a legal lateral retreat route.
Only for an individual star whose required directional, orbit or multi-anchor grammar is not readable in the baseline envelope.
Only if the current quadrant's two-hostel handoff cannot remain readable and solvable for every frozen active member.
Only if the Seven-Hostel / Four-Sacred-Beast relation, countermeasure window and safe retreat remain distinguishable in neither a baseline nor a phased layout.

forbidden_runtime_actions: derive a source profile or qualification
authority_and_economy_boundary.unchanged_left_rule: left members cannot reconnect or receive rewards
authority_and_economy_boundary.unchanged_economy_rule: Only the existing Lingxiao mainline source fact may form the current zero-value handoff candidate; this map contract cannot expand it.

whitebox_acceptance.rule: 640x416 and session candidate sizes are diagram-unit only.
Two 96x64 public envelopes, separator and margin fit inside the 224x80 heavenly allocation.
No 384x320 global resize is implied or performed.
Every public diagram responsibility maps to a public whitebox scene or a separately named session.
Lingxiao final, Seven Star and Mansion sessions are never merged into a public map.
The gate-to-inner-court causality is readable without a long artificial backtrack.
The public-scene boundary is explicit and not portrayed as an existing seamless road.
Telegraph, countermeasure, retreat route and purification node can be read in 2.5D without decoration occlusion.
One to four active participants retain legal positions and routes; static terrain cannot create an unsolvable block.
Failure can be reconstructed from non-color-only world/UI feedback.
Observatory and tower facades do not imply live entrance, teleport or qualification behavior.
The public Lingxiao facade cannot replace TT_SPEC_SESSION_LINGXIAO_MAINLINE.
Whitebox layout creates no checkpoint, revive, reconnect or cleanup exception.
No event, qualification, material, XP, currency, drop, probability, pity or receipt is created.
